symptoms: Newborn evaluation: Term gestation? Breathing or crying? Good tone? If NO to any -> initiate resuscitation.

management_steps.details: Provide warmth, clear airway if necessary, dry and stimulate (Don't dry if < 30 weeks – wrap preterm baby's torso in plastic bag). Note the time.

If gasping, apnoeic or HR < 100/min: Start ventilating with room air (Rate: 30-40/min; 30-40% O2 if preterm). Connect to pulse oximeter. Normal pre-ductal sats target (right hand/ear): 1 min >60%, 2 min >65%, 3 min >70%, 4 min >75%, 5 min >80%, >10 min 90-95%.

If HR < 60/min despite 30s effective PPV: Consider intubation. Start chest compressions coordinated with ventilation (3 compressions : 1 breath, cycle 2 seconds) with 100% O2. Give 0.1-0.3ml/kg Adrenaline IV of 1:10 000 dilution (1ml/kg via ETT if no IV access). Repeat IV q3-5min. Correct hypovolaemia with 10ml/kg normal saline over 5-10 minutes.

warnings: Don't dry preterm infants < 30 weeks gestation; wrap torso in plastic bag to preserve temperature.
